department: Department of Computer Science (DIKU, Faculty of SCIENCE PhD School)

deadline.value: No central deadline: PhD scholarships are advertised as open positions at DIKU and on the UCPH job portal, each with its own deadline.
deadline.quote: See all open positions at DIKU including PhD scholarships.

also.quote: Look for advertised PhD positions at the University's job portal.

supervisor.value: You must have an agreement with a principal supervisor at the Faculty of Science before you apply for admission.
supervisor.quote: You must have a principal supervisor employed at one of the departments at the Faculty of Science, and you must have an agreement with your supervisor before you apply for admission.

also.quote: Applicants must have an agreement with a principal supervisor.

funding.value: No unfunded admission: you need funding for salary and tuition fee to enrol, usually employment as a PhD fellow.
funding.quote: To be enrolled as a PhD student, the applicant must have funding for salary and tuition fee. | Employment as a PhD fellow at the faculty

entry_route.value: Admission is based on a qualification equivalent to a Danish two-year master's degree (120 ECTS); most students enter this way.
entry_route.quote: Admission to the PhD programme is based on qualifications equivalent to a Danish two-year master's degree (120 ECTS).

also.quote: The majority of PhD students are admitted through the 5+3 entry, allowing 3 years of full-time PhD studies.

gre_subject.value: Not stated on the pages checked

notes: Programme described as three years: 'A PhD programme is a 3 year research programme carried out in close cooperation with researchers.'
